description:
**File**: `src/services/memory_manager_actor.cr:284-292`

**Severity**: P3 (dead code, confusing, masks fiber count)

```crystal
if @consecutive_high >= 5
  Log.for("quickheadlines.memory").error { "Sustained critical memory pressure, considering restart" }
  RefreshLoop::FiberTracker.tracked_spawn do
    sleep(5.seconds)
    unless QuickHeadlines.shutting_down?
      Log.for("quickheadlines.memory").warn { "Initiating graceful restart due to memory pressure" }
    end
  end
end
```

The comment says "considering restart" but the spawn only logs a
warning — it never actually restarts. The fiber IS tracked, so it
counts toward `FiberTracker.active_fibers`, masking the real
fiber count in leak diagnostics.

This is a known issue called out in `quickhea-hwp` ("Add periodic
forced full GC to MemoryManagerActor") which is a different fix;
this ticket is specifically about the dead spawn.

**Fix**: Either
1. Implement the restart (`exit 1` to let the supervisor restart,
   or signal `QuickHeadlines.initiate_shutdown`), or
2. Remove the spawn entirely

Found during code review 2026-06-18, see
`planning/code-review-2026-06-18.md` §2.2.
title: Dead 'restart' fiber in MemoryManagerActor.handle_check_and_gc
